Open Start and type your company name and your own rules in the yellow cells: price and stock tolerances, service warning days, hire limit, truck size, standard waste and the score you expect from a supplier.
Fill Suppliers, Projects and Materials. Orders, spend, late orders and price trends fill in from the other sheets.
Log every request from site on Requisitions. It turns to Ordered when an order for that project and material exists, and warns when the needed date passes.
Enter each purchase order on Purchase Orders with the supplier, project, material, quantity, price and promised date. Received, outstanding and the status fill in from Deliveries.
Record every delivery note on Deliveries with the quantity delivered and rejected. Days late and lead time fill in, and Supplier Performance gives each supplier a score.
Enter each supplier invoice on Supplier Invoices. The check compares it with the order price and the quantity you accepted, and shows the amount billed above what you owe.
Keep Material Usage and Stock on Site up to date with the quantities used and counted. Reorder warnings and the cost of overruns fill in.
List every machine on Equipment Register, place it on projects on Equipment Allocation, and log hire, service, fuel and breakdowns on their sheets.
Record small tools you issue on Small Tools and goods you send back on Returns and Credits until the credit note arrives.

Use the 14 calculators for order quantities, concrete, rebar, blocks, paint and tile, hire or buy, cost per day, fuel, the three-way match, reorder point, delay cost, supplier offers, stock cover and waste.
Read Procurement and Equipment Dashboard and Charts every week: late orders, requisitions not ordered, invoices that differ, low stock, services due and hires that run long.
Control subcontractors, payments, crews and labour cost in one workbook
Control subcontractors, payments, crews and labour cost
work done to date less retention less earlier payments gives the payment due, the days open, late interest and a status that shows what is overdue or disputed
each package shows work certified, its retention rate and the retention held, and the subcontractor sheet adds it up across packages
insurance, licence, safety plan and tax certificates show days left and warn before they end, with the subcontractors that must stop work
each variation shows its reason, amount, days waiting and whether it needs a decision, and approved ones change the package value
quality, safety, programme and tidiness scores give a band and an average for each subcontractor that feeds its status
Weekly timesheets costed at loaded rates
normal and overtime hours for every worker and week are costed with wage, on-costs and overtime factor, and checked against the weekly overtime limit
Crews with own and agency workers
each gang shows its target size, own workers, agency workers, the gap and the hours worked over the last four weeks
output for each worker-day is compared with the planned rate by trade and the lost days are priced
every course shows its end date, days left and a status, and a worker with an ended certificate is shown as not cleared for site
Labour cost against budget by project
own labour and subcontract work certified are added for each project and compared with its labour budget
the workers needed and booked for each trade and date give the gap, the days to start and the weekly agency cost of covering it
hours, overtime share, cost, absence cost and subcontract payments for each month show the amount accrued but not yet paid

Projects with their subcontract and own labour share
One row for each project; the subcontract value, its share of the contract, own labour cost to date and open worker gaps fill in from the other sheets.
Subcontractors: value, retention, rating and documents
One row for each subcontractor; packages, value, work certified, retention held, paid, average rating and a status for expired documents fill in.
Subcontract packages: value, retention, progress and dates
One row for each package placed with a subcontractor; approved variations, the revised value, work certified, retention held, paid, balance and a status fill in.
One row for each document a subcontractor must hold; days left and a status that warns before the document ends fill in.
Payment applications: work done less retention
One row for each monthly application with the work done to date and what was paid before; retention, the payment due, days open, a status and late interest fill in.
Subcontractor variations: extra work, changes and omissions
One row for each variation with its reason, amount and decision; the days it has waited and a status that shows which ones need a decision fill in.
Subcontractor performance ratings after each review
One row for each review with scores from 1 to 5 for quality, safety, programme and tidiness; the score and a band fill in, and the subcontractor average follows.
Crews and gangs with own workers and agency labour
One row for each gang with its trade, project and target size; own workers, total, the gap and the hours worked in the last four weeks fill in.
Own workers: crew, wage, loaded cost, use and certificates
One row for each worker with trade, crew and wage; the loaded hour, overtime hour, hours in the last four weeks, utilisation, absence days and site status fill in.
Weekly timesheets: hours, overtime and cost for every worker
One row for each worker and week with the project, normal hours and overtime hours; the cost at the loaded rates, total hours and an overtime limit check fill in.
Approved overtime with reason and premium cost
One row for each approved overtime shift with its reason; the cost of the hours and the premium over normal time fill in.
Labour productivity: output for each worker-day against plan
One row for each measured activity with the quantity done and the worker-days used; output for each worker-day, the gap to plan, worker-days lost and their cost fill in.
Absence log with reason, days and cost
One row for each absence with its reason and days; the cost of the paid days and a flag for a missing medical certificate fill in.
Training and safety certificates with expiry dates
One row for each course passed with how many months it stays valid; the end date, days left and a status that warns before it ends fill in.
Labour cost by project against budget
One row for each project with its labour budget; own hours and cost, overtime share, subcontract work certified, the total against the budget and a status fill in.
Site induction records with score and card issued
One row for each person inducted on a project with the quiz score; the pass or fail result fills in, and cards are issued only to those who pass.
Protective equipment and tools issued to workers
One row for each issue with the item, quantity, cost and life in months; the cost, the replacement date and whether it was replaced or is due fill in.
One row for each month with the amount paid by payroll; hours, overtime share, own labour cost, absence cost, subcontract payments and the amount accrued fill in from the sheets.
Labour shortages by trade and project
One row for each trade a project needs from a date; the gap, days to the start, the weekly cost of covering it with agency labour and a status fill in.
Trade rates: wage, on-costs, overtime and agency day rate
One row for each trade with the wage, on-costs, overtime factor and agency day rate; the loaded hour, the cost of a day and which is cheaper fill in.

Hello {contact}, welcome to our list of subcontractors. Please send your insurance certificate, licence and safety plan before you start any work with us.
Ask a subcontractor for its programme
Hello {contact}, can you send us your programme and the number of workers you will have on site? We need it for our weekly plan.
Hello, we have sent you the order for {scope} on "{proj}" at {value}. Please sign it and send your programme before {start}.
Confirm the start with a subcontractor
Hello, we expect you to start {scope} on "{proj}" on {start}. Please confirm that your team and materials will be ready.
Hello, your work on "{proj}" must finish on {finish}. Please tell us today if the date is at risk.
Ask a subcontractor to close the snags
Hello, please finish the snag items for {scope} on "{proj}". We release your retention after the work is accepted.
Hello, we received your application of {date} for "{proj}". We will visit the work and send the payment notice soon.
Hello, we certified {due} for your application on "{proj}". We will pay within the days agreed in your subcontract.
Tell a subcontractor a payment was sent
Hello, we paid {due} for your application of {date} on "{proj}". Please check your account and tell us if anything is missing.
Hello, your application of {date} on "{proj}" is late. We will pay {due} this week with interest of {interest}. We are sorry for the delay.
Hello, we need to check the measurements in your application of {date} on "{proj}". When can you meet us on site?
Ask for the price of a variation
Hello, please send your price and the extra days for this change on "{proj}": {description}. Do not start before we confirm.
Hello, we approve the variation on "{proj}" for {amount}: {description}. Please start and add it to your next application.
Hello, we cannot accept the variation on "{proj}": {description}. Please call us so that we can explain.
Say a variation is still being decided
Hello, your variation on "{proj}" has waited {days_open} days. The client has not decided yet. We will chase this week.
Hello, your {type} ends on {expiry}, in {days_left} days. Please send the renewed document before then.
Stop work for an ended document
Hello, your {type} ended on {expiry}. Your team cannot work on our sites and we cannot pay applications until we have the new document.
Hello, please send your current {type} for our files. It must name your site supervisor and your emergency contact.
Thank a subcontractor for good work
Hello, our review of your work on "{proj}" scored {score} out of 5. Thank you. We want to invite you for our next projects.
Hello, our review of your work on "{proj}" scored {score} out of 5. We need to meet this week and agree how you will improve.
Hello {name}, welcome to the team. Please come to the site office at 7:00 for your induction and bring your documents.
Ask a worker to confirm the start
Hello {name}, please confirm that you will start on Monday. Your supervisor will meet you at the gate.
Tell a worker a certificate is ending
Hello {name}, your {course} certificate ends on {expiry}, in {days_left} days. We will book your renewal. Please tell us the days you can attend.
Hello {name}, we booked your {course} renewal. Please bring your old certificate and your identity card.
Hello {name}, can you work {hours} extra hours on {date} on "{proj}"? Overtime is paid at the overtime rate.
Hello {name}, thank you for the {hours} extra hours on {date}. They will be paid with your next wage.
Ask a worker about an absence
Hello {name}, we noted your absence on {date}. Please send your medical certificate if you were sick for 3 days or more.
Tell a worker equipment needs replacing
Hello {name}, your {item} should be replaced by {replace_on}. Please come to the store with the old one.
We place this package with you for {col:pkgs.value}. The work starts on {col:pkgs.start} and finishes on {col:pkgs.finish}. We hold retention of {col:pkgs.ret_pct} from each payment.
Please send your programme, your safety plan and your insurance certificate before you start, and keep your documents valid for the whole of the work.
We have checked your application. The work done to date is {col:apps.cum_work}, retention held is {col:apps.ret} and payments made before are {col:apps.prev}. The payment due is {col:apps.due}.
We will pay this amount within the payment days agreed in your subcontract. If you disagree, tell us in writing with your measurements.
Reminder to renew a compliance document
This document ends on {col:docs.expiry}. Please send us the renewed document before that date.
We cannot allow your workers on site and we cannot pay applications while a required document is not valid.
Instruction to carry out a variation
Change: {col:vars.description}. Reason: {col:vars.reason}. The agreed amount is {col:vars.amount}.
Please do not start the work until you have a signed copy of this instruction. Add the amount to your next payment application once the work is done.
Our review gave you a score of {col:ratings.score} out of 5 for quality, safety, programme and tidiness. This is below the level we need.
Please send us a written plan within seven days that shows how you will improve, and let us meet your team on site this week.
Request to complete and release retention
The finish date of your package is {col:pkgs.finish}. So far {col:pkgs.certified} is certified and {col:pkgs.held} is held as retention.
Please finish the snag items, remove your equipment and waste and send your final account. We release retention after practical completion and the defects period of the subcontract.
{col:induct.person} of {col:induct.company} attended the site induction for {col:induct.proj} on {col:induct.date}.
The score was {col:induct.score} out of 100 and the result is {col:induct.state}. Only people who pass may work on site, and they must wear the protective equipment shown at the induction.
Notice that a certificate is ending
Your certificate ends on {col:train.expiry}. We will book a renewal course for you before that date. You may not do work that needs this certificate after it ends.
Offer of work to a worker
We offer you work from {col:workers.hired} at {col:workers.wage} for each hour. Overtime is paid at the rate that applies to your trade and must be approved by your supervisor.
You must pass the site induction, wear the protective equipment we issue and keep your training certificates valid.
